entry.name: jit.gl.sketch

messages.name: screentoworld
messages.digest: Convert screen coordinates to world coordinates
messages.description: The word, followed by a pair of numbers that specifyandcoordinates, returns an array containing the,, andworld coordinates associated with a given screen pixel using the same the depth from the camera as 0,0,0. Optionally a third depth arg may be specified, which may be useful for hit detection and other applications. The depth value is typically specified in the range 0.-1. where 0 is the near clipping plane, and 1. is the far clipping plane.

messages.name: shapeorient
messages.description: Sets the current orientation for shape drawing commands (,,,,,,,, and). The,, andarguments are in terms of degrees (0-360). The order in which the orientation is applied is first rotate about x axis, then rotate about y axis, and finally rotate about z axis.

messages.name: strokeparam
messages.description: The word, followed by a parameter name argument and a list of parameter values, sets the current value of the parameter specified by theargument to be the value specified byargument(s). Some parameters are global for the extent of a stroked path definition, while others may vary on a point by point basis.

messages.name: strokepoint
messages.digest: Define a stroked path anchor point
messages.description: The word, followed by three numbers that specify,,coordinates, defines an anchor point at the location specified by those coordinates. Some stroke styles (such as basic2d) will ignore thecoordinate.
